; PROBE (not part of the mod): does ThumbnailProvider render a page at full screen
; resolution, and does it include strokes made since the document was opened?
;
; If yes, the sleep window can render the pinned PAGE directly instead of replaying a
; framebuffer capture: no overlays in the image, no capture timing, no merge helper.
;
; Enable:  add "probe": true to /home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.json, then open the
;          pinned page -> the rendered page covers the scene fullscreen.
; Judge:   rm-shot it and diff sharpness against a normal framebuffer capture of the page;
;          then write strokes, leave/re-enter, and check they appear.
; Disable: drop the "probe" key (or remove this qmd) and restart xochitl.
;
; DeviceSceneView already imports com.remarkable, so Library/ThumbnailProvider need no
; new import here. Wrapped in an id'd child Item like everything else (root-level
; attached handlers collide with the other mods).

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
	TRAVERSE ?#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: probeThumb
				anchors.fill: parent
				z: 9000
				visible: probeThumb.on && probeThumb.doc !== null

				property bool on: false
				property string docId: ""
				property int pageIdx: -1
				property var doc: null

				function reload() {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
						probeThumb.on = false;
						probeThumb.doc = null;
						try {
							var j = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
							if (!j.probe || !j.docId) return;
							probeThumb.docId = j.docId;
							probeThumb.pageIdx = (j.pageIdx !== undefined) ? j.pageIdx : 0;
							var d = Library.entryForId(j.docId);
							if (!d) {
								console.log("PROBE: entryForId returned null for", j.docId);
								return;
							}
							probeThumb.doc = d;
							probeThumb.on = true;
							console.log("PROBE: rendering", j.docId, "page", probeThumb.pageIdx,
								"source=", probeProvider.source);
						} catch (e) {
							console.log("PROBE: state read failed", e);
						}
					};
					xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.json");
					xhr.send();
				}

				ThumbnailProvider {
					id: probeProvider
					document: probeThumb.doc
					page: probeThumb.pageIdx
					monochrome: false
					cache: false
				}

				Rectangle {
					anchors.fill: parent
					color: "white"
				}

				Image {
					id: probeImage
					anchors.fill: parent
					source: probeProvider.source
					sourceSize: Qt.size(954, 1696)
					fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
					asynchronous: true
					cache: false
					onStatusChanged: {
						if (status === Image.Ready)
							console.log("PROBE: ready, implicit",
								implicitWidth + "x" + implicitHeight,
								"painted", paintedWidth + "x" + paintedHeight);
						else if (status === Image.Error)
							console.log("PROBE: image error for", source);
					}
				}

				Connections {
					target: root
					function onPageChanged() { probeThumb.reload(); }
					function onDocumentChanged() { probeThumb.reload(); }
				}

				Component.onCompleted: probeThumb.reload()
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
